question: Can I see an out-of-network doctor if I pay a bit more?
answer: No. Your HMO plan has no option to pay more to see an out-of-network doctor. It only pays for out-of-network care in an emergency, even if you have a referral. If you see an out-of-network doctor for non-emergency care, you pay the full cost. That money also won't count toward your deductible or out-of-pocket limit. To get coverage, use your in-network primary care provider (PCP). You need a referral from your PCP before seeing an in-network specialist. Without one, the visit isn't covered. Emergency room care is covered in or out of network at 40% coinsurance after the deductible.
